name: Free up storage (clear caches)
summary: Trims cached junk from apps to reclaim space on a nearly-full TV box. Only caches are cleared — no apps, logins or user data are touched, and caches rebuild on their own.
notes: Nothing to undo: caches are temporary files that apps regenerate automatically.

steps.label: This clears only app caches. Your apps, accounts and settings are untouched.
Trim all app caches to reclaim space
